notes.title: Itty Bitty Little Kitties Demo Update v1.10
notes.notes: After some feedback we have reduced the countdown for the hint timer from 2 minutes down to 60 seconds. This means you can now use a hint once every 60 seconds when you get stuck.

notes.title: Itty Bitty Little Kitties Demo is Nearing Release
notes.notes: The demo for [i][b]Itty Bitty Little Kitties[/b][/i] is complete and has been submitted to [i]Steam[/i] for review. We've got our fingers crossed and hoping that everything goes smoothly for a release in March.
